grade: 七年级上 ~ 八年级上
summary: 「某地有某物」：There is + 单数/不可数名词，There are + 复数名词。be 动词遵循「就近原则」。

rules.title: 基本结构：There is / are + 名词 + 地点/时间
rules.detail: is 后接单数可数名词或不可数名词；are 后接复数名词。表示「存在有」，注意和 have（某人拥有）区分。

examples.en: There is a park near my home.
There are 45 desks in our classroom.
examples.zh: 我们教室里有 45 张课桌。

examples.en: There is some milk in the fridge.

rules.title: 就近原则：be 动词由紧挨着它的名词决定
rules.detail: be 动词由紧挨着它的名词决定：靠近的是单数名词或不可数名词用 is，靠近复数名词用 are。对比：There is a pen and two books. / There are two books and a pen.（意思相同，be 动词不同）

examples.en: There is a pen and two books on the desk.
examples.zh: 课桌上有一支钢笔和两本书。

examples.en: There are two books and a pen on the desk.
examples.zh: 课桌上有两本书和一支钢笔。

rules.title: 否定句与疑问句
rules.detail: 否定：There isn't / aren't any...（some 变 any）；一般疑问句：Is / Are there...? 肯定回答 Yes, there is/are. 否定回答 No, there isn't/aren't.

examples.en: There isn't any water in the bottle.
Are there any apples on the tree? — Yes, there are.

pitfalls: there be 和 have 混用：❌ There has a book on the desk. → ✓ There is a book on the desk.（There be 表「存在」，have 表「拥有」）
就近原则没掌握：❌ There is two chairs in the room. → ✓ There are two chairs in the room.
否定句 some 没变 any：❌ There isn't some milk. → ✓ There isn't any milk.

questions.stem: ___ a map of China on the wall?
questions.explain: a map 是单数，一般疑问句把 is 提前：Is there...?

questions.stem: There ___ some bread and three eggs on the table.
questions.explain: some bread 不可数且紧挨着 be 动词，遵循就近原则用 is。

questions.stem: How many students ___ in your class?
questions.explain: students 是复数，How many 后用 are there 提问。
milk 不可数用 is；疑问句把 is 提前，some 需变为 any。

questions.stem: There ___ (be) two banks and a supermarket near here.
questions.explain: 就近原则：紧挨着 be 动词的是 two banks（复数），用 are。

questions.stem: There ___ (be not) any juice in the fridge now.
questions.explain: juice 不可数用 is；否定形式 isn't。

questions.stem: There have many beautiful flowers in the garden.
questions.explain: 「某地有某物」用 there be 句型，many flowers 是复数用 are。

questions.stem: 教室里有一台电脑和二十张椅子。（翻译整句）
answer: there is a computer and twenty chairs in the classroom.
there is one computer and twenty chairs in the classroom.
questions.explain: 就近原则：a computer 单数紧挨 be 动词，用 There is。

questions.stem: 瓶子里没有水了。（翻译整句）
answer: there isn't any water in the bottle.
there is no water in the bottle.
there isn't any water in the bottle now.
questions.explain: 否定句 some 变 any，也可以用 There is no water。
